stories.h: Sunday bus detours: Kirkland Turkey Trot, Route 65, ST 556
stories.s: Routes 230, 231 and 255 skip some Kirkland stops from 8:30 to 11:30 a.m. Route 65 is detoured off Roosevelt Way NE and ST 556 off Bellevue Way NE until early Monday.

stories.h: Seattle/King County free clinic will end after 2027
stories.s: Organizers say the annual Seattle Center clinic has become unsustainable due to rising costs and fundraising problems. Its last event runs April 29 to May 2, 2027; it serves about 3,000 uninsured or underinsured patients a year.

stories.h: Seattle man charged in long-running immigration fraud scheme
stories.s: Mustafa Aman, 39, faces a six-count federal indictment. Prosecutors allege he faked recommendation letters and job records from 2013 to 2024 to help friends and family get visas, including Afghan Special Immigrant Visas.

stories.h: Westlake Park holiday carousel returns after five-year gap
stories.s: The downtown Seattle carousel, which first ran in 1987, returns Nov. 27 with the tree lighting and runs through Jan. 3.

coming.h: Final public comment on Seattle's 2027-28 budget
coming.s: The Select Budget Committee holds its last scheduled public comment period at 1 p.m., ahead of final adoption of Mayor Wilson's $9.1 billion budget.
